issues.description: The problem statement contains conflicting parameter type information for the addGuestStudents method: the textual task description specifies addGuestStudents(String) while the UML diagram and the solution implementation use addGuestStudents(int). This inconsistency can confuse students about the correct parameter type to implement and which tests the method should satisfy.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the problem statement so the textual description matches the UML and solution: change addGuestStudents(String) to addGuestStudents(int). Optionally, clarify in the task description that the method accepts an integer number of new guest students. Ensure the template's TODO and any example code/comments consistently reference the int parameter.
